preconditions.description: The length of the magic string T must be between 1 and 100000.
The number of bouquets N must be between 1 and 600.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in T)
preconditions.description: The magic string T must consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of distinct decorations as a string.
The number of distinct decorations must be non-negative.
The number of distinct decorations must not exceed the number of bouquets N.
